text: Could you turn all five attached pictures—the dog pic, the surprised cat pic, the two friends pic, the woman's portrait, and the lake pic—into a reel for me? I thought it would be nice to do something with these pictures instead of just leaving them sitting around. What I mean is one 8-second vertical 9:16 reel using the whole set. Make it fun, and you can pick the vibe, the order, the editing style, any music, sound effects or voice, and any captions, wording or language. I'm curious to see what you come up with because I don't really have a particular vision in mind.
